Subject: Proposed architecture deep-dive (Wed May 28)

Alex —

Following up from last week's intro call: we'd like to schedule a focused architecture deep-dive to walk through how Redwood would integrate with Solvex's data flow and operational constraints. Proposed agenda (30–45m):

- Quick context (5m)
- Proposed infra & network/hardening diagram (10–15m)
- Routing, caching, and SLA expectations (10m)
- Q&A / next steps (10m)

Suggested slot: Wed, May 28 at 11:00 AM PT (30–45m). I've attached the initial architecture sketch so your team can scan ahead.

(attachment: solvex-proposed-arch-v1.pdf — 450KB PDF)

Please let us know if that time works or share a couple of alternatives. If useful, Hannah (CS lead) and I will both join.

Thanks,

- Wed Jun 2, 11:30–12:15
